skill.summary: Complete A-Z Discord server administration. Channel/role/member management, AutoMod, webhooks, templates, audit logs, scheduled events, threads, and full server control via CLI.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of complete Discord server administration via CLI.

- Provides full control of Discord servers: manage channels, roles, members, AutoMod, webhooks, templates, audit logs, scheduled events, and threads.
- Supports advanced moderation tools: mass actions, timeouts, audit log access, and detailed permission management.
- Includes AutoMod with keyword, preset, regex, block list, and fine-grained action configuration.
- Enables bulk operations for channels, roles, and member moderation.
- All commands accessible via a structured bash interface for automation and scripting.
